messages:
morgan: Heads-up — release CI red on the SDK publish due to a regen diff from the sample app onboarding flow. Noticed parity skew with auth retry signatures.

tara: Ugh. Which job failed? link: https://ci.internal/reports/9876 (CI shows typegen-regendiff) :grimacing:

morgan: job is `typegen-regendiff` on linux-x64. Failing output pasted below:
```
--- a/js-sdk/src/generated/api.ts
+++ b/js-sdk/src/generated/api.ts
@@ -120,7 +120,7 @@
-  retryConfig?: RetryOptions;
+  retry_config?: RetryOptions;
```
Looks like property casing/order changed in the OpenAPI -> typegen pass.

sam: That diff screams openapi property sorting change. Did anyone flip `preserveOrder` in the regen step?

morgan: I didn't touch the generator flags. My local regen reproduces it if I run latest `openapi-regen` (v3.2.0). Old CI runs v3.1.x.

jules: v3.2.0 included the new stable sort to make diffs deterministic across envs, but it also normalizes snake_case for some vendor extensions (long story). That could explain `retry_config` landing instead of `retryConfig`.

tara: For the release gate we have a semver/changelog check that fails when the generated types change unexpectedly. Right now the publish is blocked. :(

dev-release-bot: release-check:semver FAILED — regen diff detected in artifacts (see job typegen-regendiff). To unblock, either update changelog/semver or revert the regenerator change.

sam: Short-term workaround: pin the codegen to v3.1.* in CI to unblock the publish, and open an ops ticket to plan a coordinated regen/semver bump.

jules: Agreed. Long-term: we should add an explicit property-mapping layer so OpenAPI renames don't leak into SDK surface changes. Also add a smoke test in sampleapp onboarding that verifies auth/retry param names.

morgan: I'll push a CI change to pin the toolchain and then run a full regen branch to view all diffs. If diffs are only casing, we can do a minor semver + changelog note. If behaviour changed, we need a proper rollback.

tara: Please also add a short note in the release checklist: "verify typegen version and property casing parity vs previous release". This bit of friction is killing onboarding for new customers when sample apps diverge.

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by morgan — job 9876 rerun queued.

morgan: Doing the regen on a branch now and will post the diff summary here. If anyone wants to triage, ping me. @sam @jules

sam: I'll help look at the generated tests for auth retry — want to make sure we didn't break interface shape for existing callers.

jules: I'll draft the changelog blurb if we need to ship a minor bump. If we end up reverting the generator change, we should document the rationale in the changelog too.
